_about: THE Interested-quiet subsequence: both the copy Lorenzo reviews and the exact POST /subsequences body that changesets/instantly_subsequences/apply_subsequences.py sends (keys starting with _ are stripped first). Fixed-copy D1/D3/D7 fallback for when services/reply_engine/cadence.py, which owns the real fresh-slot follow-up, is down. Field names follow config/instantly_api_contract.md (verified 2026-09-21): conditions is required, the schedule key is subsequence_schedule, and pre_delay on step 1 is what makes the first email land on day 1 instead of on the move. Leads are meant to be enrolled only by an explicit move, one lead per call, and only when slots were offered and went unanswered. The conditions object is sent with two empty lists and no reply_contains, but HOW INSTANTLY EVALUATES AN EMPTY CONDITION SET IS UNVERIFIED: runbooks/phase0.md go-live step 10 requires the new subsequence's enrolled-lead count to be read immediately after the first create and the subsequence deleted if it is not 0. Nothing is applied until Lorenzo approves.
booking_url_note: VERIFIED 2026-09-21: HTTP 200, page title 'Discovery Call'. Safe to use in outbound copy.
move_endpoint: POST /leads/subsequence/move {id, subsequence_id}, one call per lead (shared.instantly.Instantly.move_leads_to_subsequence). There is no `ids` array on this endpoint.
